summary: File selection via button or drag and drop, with type, size, and count checks, and a list with status and removal. Uploading is delegated to the consumer.
whenToUse: Form attachments, document or image uploads.
whenNotToUse: Avatars or images with cropping: a dedicated editor is needed.

props.name: label / description / errorMessage
props.description: Field anatomy; the group is labelled by the label.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled list ({ id, file, status, progress?, error? }).

props.name: onFilesAdded
props.description: New accepted files: start the upload here and update the status via value.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Rejected files with a reason: type, size, or count.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Maximum size of each file in bytes.

props.name: allowsMultiple
props.description: With false, a new file replaces the previous one.

props.name: showPreviews
props.description: Image thumbnails: object URLs are revoked on removal/unmount.

keyboard.action: Reaches “Sfoglia file” and the remove buttons.

accessibility: Drag and drop is an alternative: everything is also possible with the button.
Constraints and errors are linked to the button via aria-describedby; rejected files are announced in a live region.
Each file's status is shown as text (Pronto, Caricamento, Caricato, Non riuscito), not just color.
responsive: Full-width drop zone and list; long names wrap.
customization: className and style on the container; all system strings can be translated with LocaleProvider.
commonMistakes: Treating client-side validation as sufficient: type and size must be checked again on the server (including the content, not just the extension).
Forgetting to update the status after the upload: the component makes no network requests.
limits: Client-side validation doesn't replace server-side validation.
The type check relies on the MIME type/extension reported by the browser, not on the content.
